messages:
deploybot: initiating online migration apply add_account_state_flag v3 across tenant-shards. planned workers=4, rate_cap=80rps, start=15:00 UTC
sam: holding—infra-bot shows elevated lock_waits on izzy-db-primary (avg 120ms). last index apply we hit deadlocks when parallel workers were >2
msi: +1 hold. prefer canary single-shard apply first. also set workers=1 and add lock-timeout tweak: `SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '3s';`
infra-bot: METRIC: db.lock_wait_avg > 100ms on izzy-db-primary for 6m. see https://metrics/izzy-db/lock_waits
lydia: pausing rollout: `redwood rollout pause --deployment migrations/add_account_state_flag`
deploybot: Rollout paused by lydia at 2026-03-21T15:00:50Z. awaiting operator resume. :pause_button:
sam: plan: resume only shard-2 as canary, workers=1, rate_cap=5rps, lock_timeout=3s. verify no deadlocks and no partial flag rows.
msi: preparing quick consistency check: `SELECT id FROM accounts WHERE state_flag IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50;`
lydia: also pin migrator image to digest `gcr.io/redwood/migrator@sha256:1234dead` to avoid rolling scheduler changes during window
sam: approved. if canary OK for 10m, scale to workers=2 for remaining low-traffic shards. escape hatch: set feature-flag `ff:account_state_apply=false` to immediately stop consumers of new flag
deploybot: note added to release-notes: "add_account_state_flag paused by oncall due to DB lock_waits; shard-2 canary scheduled. No schema rollback."
msi: filing ENG-6802 to investigate lock contention during concurrent DDL+backfill. will follow up with post-mortem if any anomalies
lydia: thread pinned and will be referenced in changelog under release window. :pushpin:
